release.title: Tokens to Ink v6
release.notes:
- Added print-ready CMYK export with crop and registration marks, colour bars and real bleed, so files come out ready for the printer.
- Redesigned the export screen as an inline layout with clear cards for the output and marks options, replacing the old pop-up.
- Added options to convert placed images to CMYK and to export the TIFF with a transparent or white background.
